introduction: Provides a sandboxed Starlark script runner tool (code_mode) that executes multi-step tool workflows, concurrency fan-outs, and intermediate data filtering inside a single tool invocation with strict sandboxing, resource budgets, and telemetry ledger tracking.

glossary.Starlark: A deterministic, hermetic Python-dialect configuration and scripting language executed in Go via go.starlark.net with no ambient host access.
glossary.ToolError: A dedicated Starlark value returned by bound tool functions on failure, allowing script-level error inspection without raising exceptions.
glossary.call descriptor: A structured Starlark representation produced by call(tool, **kwargs) specifying a tool and arguments for parallel dispatch.
glossary.code mode: A sandboxed tool execution paradigm where an LLM writes scripts in a restricted language (Starlark) to orchestrate multi-step tool workflows and data filtering in a single turn.
glossary.middle truncation: An output reduction strategy that preserves the beginning and end of text output while eliding the middle with an informational marker.
glossary.telemetry ledger: An in-memory audit record tracking the status, arguments, and outcomes of all nested tool calls executed within a script.

requirements.title: Code mode tool construction and reachability validation
requirements.rationale: Validating tool names and preventing recursive code mode nesting at construction ensures safe reachability declarations and prevents infinite execution recursion.

criteria.condition: codemode.New is called with a slice of tools and codemode.Options
criteria.action: construct a core.Tool whose Name matches opts.Name (defaulting to 'code_mode'), ReachableTools matches the input tools, and Execute dispatches to the script runner
define InputSchema requiring a string property 'script' and OutputSchema specifying output string, return_value any, and calls_completed array

criteria.condition: codemode.New is called where any tool in tools matches opts.Name or is an existing code-mode tool
criteria.action: reject construction and return an error preventing code-mode self-nesting
criteria.contract: returns an error containing 'codemode: cannot bind code_mode tool inside code_mode'

criteria.condition: codemode.New is called with duplicate tool names in the tools slice
criteria.action: reject construction and return an error naming the duplicated tool name
criteria.contract: returns an error containing 'codemode: duplicate tool name: <name>'

criteria.condition: opts.Guidelines is provided in Options
criteria.action: assign the custom guidelines to core.Tool.PromptGuidelines, or populate default code-mode guidance when omitted
for any valid tool slice and options passed to codemode.New, return a BuildInfo reporting DescriptionBytes, DescriptionChars, and BoundToolsCount matching the bound tools count and description text

requirements.title: Dynamic description and typed schema generation
requirements.rationale: Generating dynamic Starlark signatures from tool input and output schemas informs the model of available functions and parameter types without manual documentation drift.

criteria.condition: codemode.New constructs a tool description
criteria.action: use opts.Description directly as the tool description without dynamic rendering

criteria.condition: codemode.New constructs a tool description
criteria.action: render the description by combining the runtime instructions template with typed Starlark function signatures derived from bound tools

criteria.condition: opts.DescriptionTemplate is configured in Options
criteria.action: render the instructions section using the caller-supplied Go text/template string in place of the default template
for any bound tool with an InputSchema, generate a Starlark signature mapping JSON Schema property types to str, int, float, bool, list, or dict, marking optional fields with '= None'

criteria.condition: the schema generator inspects a bound tool with a non-nil OutputSchema
criteria.action: render the documented return type using the OutputSchema field names and types, defaulting to 'Any' when OutputSchema is nil
document runtime constraints in the instructions section including keyword-only arguments, error return conventions, parallel execution, and lack of ambient I/O

requirements.title: Sandboxed Starlark runtime isolation
requirements.rationale: Restricting Starlark globals and module loaders ensures model scripts cannot access the host filesystem, network, environment variables, or execution clock.

criteria.condition: a code-mode script invocation begins execution
criteria.action: create an isolated starlark.Thread populated with safe language builtins, bound tool callables, and helpers parallel, call, and is_error

criteria.condition: a script attempts to execute a load statement
criteria.action: refuse dynamic module loading and fail the thread
criteria.contract: returns an error stating 'load is not permitted in code_mode scripts'

criteria.action: for any script execution, omit all host system primitives including open, os, socket, http, os.environ, subprocesses, and time functions from module globals

requirements.title: Keyword-argument tool bindings and invocation
requirements.rationale: Binding tools as keyword-only functions guarantees parameter mapping fidelity to underlying JSON schemas while preventing argument position misalignment.

criteria.condition: a script invokes a bound tool function with one or more positional arguments
criteria.action: reject the call and halt the function execution with a Starlark error
criteria.contract: returns a Starlark error containing '<tool> only accepts keyword arguments'

criteria.condition: a bound tool is invoked with keyword arguments
criteria.action: convert Starlark argument values into Go JSON-compatible structures and dispatch a core.ToolUseBlock via core.CallNested

criteria.condition: a nested tool call dispatched via core.CallNested succeeds with OK set to true
criteria.action: convert the structured Data map into Starlark dicts, lists, and primitives and return the converted value to the script

criteria.condition: a nested tool call dispatched via core.CallNested succeeds with OK set to true
criteria.action: return a Starlark dictionary containing {'text': ToolResult.Text} to the script

criteria.condition: a nested tool call dispatched via core.CallNested returns core.ErrTerminated
criteria.action: immediately halt script execution and propagate Terminate set to true on the code-mode ToolResult
criteria.contract: code_mode tool execution stops and ToolResult.Terminate is true

criteria.condition: a nested tool call dispatched via core.CallNested is aborted by context cancellation
criteria.action: halt script execution and return an abortion failure result
criteria.contract: returns core.ToolResult with OK: false and Error: 'aborted'

requirements.title: Non-exceptional tool error values
requirements.rationale: Exposing tool errors as structured values rather than raising Starlark exceptions allows scripts to inspect error states and apply fallback logic without halting execution.

criteria.condition: a nested tool call dispatched via core.CallNested returns a ToolResult
criteria.action: construct and return a ToolError Starlark value without raising a runtime exception
for any ToolError value, set type(val) to 'tool_error', set attributes ok to False, is_error to True, error to the error code string, detail to the detail string, and data to the error payload
allow dictionary key indexing on ToolError instances for keys 'error', 'detail', 'ok', and 'is_error'

criteria.condition: the built-in helper is_error(val) is evaluated
criteria.action: return True if val is a ToolError instance, and False for all other Starlark values

requirements.title: Concurrent execution helper (parallel)
requirements.rationale: Providing parallel dispatch helper functions enables scripts to execute batches of independent tool calls concurrently up to a configurable concurrency limit.

criteria.condition: call(tool_fn, **kwargs) is executed in a script
criteria.action: return a call descriptor capturing the target tool callable and keyword arguments

criteria.condition: parallel(calls) is invoked with a list or tuple of call descriptors, tuples, or dicts
criteria.action: validate all call specifications, chunk them into batches of at most opts.MaxConcurrentCalls, and dispatch each batch via core.CallNested concurrently

criteria.condition: concurrent batch calls complete across all workers
criteria.action: assemble the converted Starlark result values into a list matching the exact original order of the input calls

criteria.condition: any nested call within parallel triggers an interceptor termination returning core.ErrTerminated
criteria.action: immediately halt parallel batch execution and return with ToolResult.Terminate set to true
criteria.contract: parallel stops remaining calls and sets Terminate: true on the code-mode result

requirements.title: Resource limits and budget enforcement
requirements.rationale: Enforcing timeouts, step limits, call counts, and output byte limits prevents runaway scripts from consuming excessive compute, memory, or context budget.

criteria.condition: script wall-clock execution time exceeds opts.MaxTimeout
criteria.action: halt execution cleanly and return a failure result identifying the timeout
criteria.contract: returns ToolResult with OK: false, Error: 'timeout', and Detail indicating the elapsed timeout limit

criteria.condition: script execution step count exceeds opts.MaxSteps configured on the Starlark thread
criteria.action: terminate script execution and return a step limit error
criteria.contract: returns ToolResult with OK: false, Error: 'step_limit_exceeded', and Detail naming the step limit

criteria.condition: cumulative nested tool calls dispatched across direct calls and parallel exceed opts.MaxCalls
criteria.action: reject the excess call, halt script execution, and return a call limit error
criteria.contract: returns ToolResult with OK: false, Error: 'call_limit_exceeded', and Detail naming the call limit

criteria.condition: cumulative printed and returned output bytes exceed opts.MaxOutputBytes
criteria.action: halt script execution and return an output limit error
criteria.contract: returns ToolResult with OK: false, Error: 'output_limit_exceeded', and Detail naming the output byte limit

criteria.condition: script execution terminates due to any exceeded limit
criteria.guard: partial printed output or completed nested calls exist
criteria.action: include the partial output and completed calls ledger in ToolResult.Data and format them in ToolResult.Text

requirements.title: Output capture, middle truncation, and disk spilling
requirements.rationale: Buffering printed output and script return values with middle truncation and spill file support prevents context blowup while preserving key beginnings and conclusions.

criteria.condition: a script calls the print built-in function
criteria.action: capture the formatted printed line into an internal tools.Accumulator configured with TruncateMiddle and capacity opts.MaxOutputBytes

criteria.condition: script evaluation concludes successfully
criteria.action: determine the return value by executing main() if defined, else reading global variable result if defined, else defaulting to None
for any script execution, format ToolResult.Text with combined printed text and return value, printed text only, formatted return value only, or '[Script finished with no output]'

criteria.condition: total output bytes exceed opts.MaxOutputBytes
criteria.action: truncate output via middle elision marker and stream full output to a spill file in opts.SpillDir

criteria.condition: total output bytes exceed opts.MaxOutputBytes
criteria.action: truncate output via middle elision marker without writing a spill file to disk

criteria.condition: output truncation occurs during script execution
criteria.action: populate core.ToolMetadata on ToolResult with Truncated: true, TruncatedBy: 'bytes', TotalBytes, SpillPath, and DurationMS

requirements.title: Script error diagnostics and telemetry ledger
requirements.rationale: Recording structured diagnostics and an execution ledger of completed calls ensures transparency for failures without rolling back side effects.

criteria.condition: a script encounters a syntax error during parsing
criteria.action: terminate execution and return a syntax error result detailing the file and line number
criteria.contract: returns ToolResult with OK: false, Error: 'syntax_error', line number, and error details

criteria.condition: a script encounters a runtime execution error such as undefined variable or type mismatch
criteria.action: terminate execution and return a runtime error result with stack and line information
criteria.contract: returns ToolResult with OK: false, Error: 'runtime_error', line number, and error details

criteria.action: for any nested tool call executed during script run, append a record containing tool name, arguments, ok status, and error code to an execution ledger

criteria.condition: a script execution completes, fails, or is halted by a limit
criteria.action: populate calls_completed in ToolResult.Data with the execution ledger and include the summary in ToolResult.Text without rolling back side effects

criteria.condition: the caller context is cancelled before or during script execution
criteria.action: halt execution cleanly and return an aborted result
criteria.contract: returns ToolResult with OK: false, Error: 'aborted', and Detail: 'Operation aborted'

requirements.title: Offline example and documentation governance
requirements.rationale: Providing an offline end-to-end example and updated documentation validates code mode without external network dependencies and maintains architectural records.

criteria.action: provide an offline runnable example in examples/codemode/main.go binding navigation tools and an in-memory MCP tool against provider/faux without network access or API keys
provide an accompanying README in examples/codemode/README.md explaining how to run and verify the offline code-mode workflow
record the dependency adoption ruling for go.starlark.net in docs/DEPS.md documenting sandboxing, step budgeting, and pure-Go rationale
update docs/architecture.md, docs/configuration.md, and README.md with the code mode architecture, codemode.Options reference, and getting started usage

execution_paths.title: Model executes a multi-step navigation and filtering script in code mode

steps.action: emits a tool call to 'code_mode' with a Starlark script that calls list_files and filters results
initializes a sandboxed Starlark thread and binds list_files as a keyword-argument function
invokes list_files(path='.') via core.CallNested and receives structured directory entries
filters the entries in Starlark and prints the filtered result list
captures printed output, formats ToolResult with the filtered list and completed calls ledger, and returns it to the agent loop

execution_paths.title: Model executes parallel tool calls inside a code mode script

steps.action: emits a tool call to 'code_mode' with a Starlark script invoking parallel([call(read_file, path=p) for p in paths])
parses call descriptors and chunks them into concurrent batches bounded by MaxConcurrentCalls
executes tool calls concurrently via core.CallNested and returns completed results
maps results to Starlark values in original call order, records execution in telemetry ledger, and returns the combined response

execution_paths.title: Script execution halts and spills output when exceeding resource limit

steps.action: emits a tool call to 'code_mode' with a script that generates large printed output exceeding MaxOutputBytes
accumulates printed output, detects MaxOutputBytes breach, and triggers middle truncation
writes full output to a spill file in SpillDir and generates an elided middle marker
returns ToolResult with OK: false, Error: 'output_limit_exceeded', Metadata with SpillPath and Truncated: true, and completed calls ledger

execution_paths.title: Script handles nested tool failure via non-exceptional ToolError

steps.action: emits a tool call to 'code_mode' with a script that calls a tool which returns OK: false and inspects the error via is_error
executes the tool call via core.CallNested and returns a failing ToolResult
constructs a ToolError Starlark value and returns it to the script without raising an exception
checks is_error(res), logs the error detail, and finishes execution with fallback data
returns ToolResult with OK: true and the fallback output to the agent loop

execution_paths.title: Offline example executes code mode agent workflow against faux provider

steps.action: runs go run ./examples/codemode against provider/faux without network access or API keys
constructs a code-mode tool binding navigation tools and an in-memory MCP tool, and starts an agent
supplies scripted turns that invoke code_mode to inspect files and execute parallel queries
executes the scripted workflows in sandboxed Starlark, runs child tools, and prints final outputs
prints the completed conversation and exits cleanly with zero status
